nodes.description: uint256 public totalDeposit; tracks the accounting of all deposited ETH
address payable public feeAddress; recipient of deposit and withdrawal fees
address payable public adminAddress; privileged address allowed to call withdraw
string public vaultName; descriptive name of the vault
uint32 public depositFeePermill = 69; deposit fee expressed in per-mille of 10000
uint32 public withdrawFeePermill = 69; withdrawal fee expressed in per-mille of 10000
address public gov; governance address controlling all setters
constructor(address payable _adminAddress, address payable _feeAddress, string memory _vaultName) initializes adminAddress, feeAddress, vaultName and gov
setFeeAddress(address payable _feeAddress) external onlyGov; writes feeAddress
setAdminAddress(address payable _adminAddress) external onlyGov; writes adminAddress
setVaultName(string memory _vaultName) external onlyGov; writes vaultName
deposit(string memory _htrAddress) external payable; computes fee/refund via SafeMath and performs ETH sends to feeAddress and msg.sender

withdraw(uint256 _amount, uint256 _estimatedGasFeeAmount, address payable _receiverAddress, string memory _htrAddress) external onlyAdmin; performs ETH sends to feeAddress, _receiverAddress and adminAddress
msg.sender; used for gov assignment, access modifiers and as ETH refund recipient in deposit
feeAddress.send(_feeAmount) with fallback feeAddress.transfer(_feeAmount) inside deposit
msg.sender.send(_returnAmount) with fallback msg.sender.transfer(_returnAmount) inside deposit; external interaction with the caller
feeAddress.send(_feeAmount) with fallback feeAddress.transfer(_feeAmount) inside withdraw
_receiverAddress.send(_realAmount) with fallback _receiverAddress.transfer(_realAmount) inside withdraw; arbitrary caller-supplied recipient
deposit parameter _htrAddress, only used in Deposited event
withdraw parameter _estimatedGasFeeAmount, gas reimbursement forwarded to adminAddress
withdraw parameter _receiverAddress payable, target of the ETH send
withdraw parameter _htrAddress, only used in Withdrawn event
